replyTo.title: Reply-to address
replyTo.description: Replies to e-mails go here. Empty: to the sender address.

retryPlan.title: Retries
retryPlan.description: Short: now, then 1 and 5 minutes later. Long: now, then 5 and 15 minutes and 1, 3 and 6 hours later. Retries go out on the next uses of your website; a message keeps the plan it was sent with.
